title: TTD allocates ₹6 crore SRIVANI funds to develop Kadapa Sivalayam
description: As such allocations require public contribution to the tune of 15% of the budget, local devotees come out in large numbers to offer support; temple chairman P. Nageswara Rao donates ₹25 lakh for the cause and hands over a cheque to the government whip and local MLA Reddeppagari Madhavi Reddy
